## Constraints

### Must

- Dark-only page: color-scheme is dark and every color comes from the tokens in src/index.css (the detected colorMode "light" is a heuristic miss).
- Mobile-first: no horizontal scroll down to 320px wide.
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion: no gradient breathing or entrance animation.
- Visible focus outline on every link and button.
- White text on primary (#e11d48) keeps at least 4.5:1 contrast; do not swap in TikTok's brighter #fe2c55 for button backgrounds.

### Avoid

- Hover scaling on buttons (use active scale only).
- transition-all.
- Hotlinked avatar URLs from TikTok's CDN; they expire. Keep the image in public/avatar.jpg.

## Decisions

- **link-in-bio-layout**: Single centered glass profile card (adapted from 21st Profile Card by ravikatiyar162) over a full-screen animated radial gradient (adapted from 21st Animated Gradient Background by hammamikhairi). (src/App.tsx)
- **sunset-palette**: Night-to-sunset gradient (purple, pink, orange, gold) drawn from the avatar, with TikTok pink and cyan as accents. (src/App.tsx)
